rationale: The Development Inspector gains opt-in live telemetry for named scalar, meter, vector, and event value channels without routing audio-thread publications through the transport. The transferred value_source.hpp surface now attaches each source to bounded telemetry state owned by its ValueChannelSet, tags publications with a monotonic generation, and moves publish/read implementations out of line so the inspector can observe snapshots without changing the existing single-writer/single-reader TripleBuffer contract. Publishing remains allocation-free and non-blocking, ordinary UI reads retain latest-value semantics, and sources detach before their telemetry owner is destroyed. This is Pulp-specific developer-tool observability with no counterpart framework behavior to backport.
